    What it does

    A chimney design takes a week in a spreadsheet.
    This does it while you type.

    The problem

    Steel stack design lives in workbooks that grew over years — dozens of linked sheets, formulas nobody wants to touch, and intermediate numbers that only make sense to whoever built it. Change the height and you re-check thirty sections by hand. Miss one blank row and a load quietly doubles.

    What changes

    Every formula is code, every code is tested against real validated designs, and every check re-runs the instant an input moves. The stack redraws as you type. Sections that fail turn red on the model before you reach the results table.

    37calculations reconciled against the source workbook
    362rows of workings, printed in every report
    6 sig. fig.agreement on 35 of those 37

    Codes applied

    Indian Standards, clause by clause.

    Nothing is a black box. Each result names the clause it came from, and every judgement-based value the original workbook hard-coded is surfaced as an editable assumption and printed in the report.

    Capabilities

    Built for the design review, not the demo.
